options.name: Blight
options.benefit: Curse an animal or plant with a wasting supernatural disease.

options.name: Cackle
options.benefit: Extend nearby agony, charm, evil eye, fortune, and misfortune hexes.

options.name: Cauldron
options.benefit: Gain Brew Potion and +4 on Craft (alchemy).

options.name: Charm
options.benefit: Improve a nearby creature's attitude for a limited time.

options.name: Coven
options.benefit: Count as a hag for joining a coven.

options.name: Disguise
options.benefit: Alter appearance for a number of hours equal to Witch level.

options.name: Evil Eye
options.benefit: Penalize a target's AC, attacks, saves, ability checks, or skill checks.

options.name: Flight
options.benefit: Gain feather fall, levitation, and eventually flight.

options.name: Fortune
options.benefit: Let an ally reroll one attack, save, ability check, or skill check each round.

options.name: Healing
options.benefit: Heal each creature once per day, improving at 5th level.

options.name: Misfortune
options.benefit: Force a creature to roll twice and take the worse result.

options.name: Nails
options.benefit: Grow retractable natural claw attacks.

options.name: Prehensile Hair
options.benefit: Use magically animated hair as a natural attack with Intelligence-based Strength.

options.name: Slumber
options.benefit: Put a creature of any Hit Dice into magical sleep.

options.name: Tongues
options.benefit: Understand and eventually speak any language for limited minutes per day.

options.name: Ward
options.benefit: Grant one creature scaling deflection and resistance bonuses.

options.name: Agony
options.benefit: Sicken and then nauseate a creature for a number of rounds.

options.name: Hag's Eye
options.benefit: Create a magical sensor shared with a coven.

options.name: Hoarfrost
options.benefit: Deal recurring Constitution damage through supernatural cold.

options.name: Major Healing
options.benefit: Heal each creature more powerfully once per day.

options.name: Nightmares
options.benefit: Afflict a creature with recurring nightmares.

options.name: Retribution
options.benefit: Cause attackers to suffer half the damage they deal.

options.name: Vision
options.benefit: Grant a divinatory vision concerning a creature touched.

options.name: Waxen Image
options.benefit: Control a target through a supernatural wax duplicate.

options.name: Weather Control
options.benefit: Control weather once per day.

options.name: Death Curse
options.benefit: Curse a creature through escalating rounds ending in death.

options.name: Dire Prophecy
options.benefit: Impose severe penalties and deny critical confirmations.

options.name: Eternal Slumber
options.benefit: Place a creature into permanent supernatural sleep.

options.name: Forced Reincarnation
options.benefit: Kill and immediately reincarnate a living creature.

options.name: Life Giver
options.benefit: Resurrect a dead creature once per day without a material component.

options.name: Natural Disaster
options.benefit: Create storm of vengeance and earthquake once per day.
